_comment: Layer 4 step 1 output (constrained decoding). In the POC this file stands in for the model: each object is exactly the JSON a schema-constrained LLM must emit for the referenced clause (schema = rulec.TypedRule). Run 04_compile_rules.py --llm to regenerate it with an LLM when OPENAI_API_KEY is set. Steps 2 and 3 (grammar parse, SHACL compile) never use a model.

rules.subject: Claim
rules.message: Flood is excluded (EXCL-FLD, MM-CP-1030 B.1.g via MM-CP-0010 Section B.1). Check for a restoring endorsement.

rules.subject: Claim
rules.message: MM-CP-E101 restores Flood only for scheduled locations and only for COV-A / COV-B (sublimit $250,000, 5% deductible).

rules.subject: Claim
rules.message: Insured must give notice of loss within 72 hours (MM-CP-0010 E.3(b)).

rules.subject: Claim
rules.message: In Florida the notice period is 14 days (MM-CP-FL-01 Section 5.3 amends E.3(b)).

rules.subject: Policy
rules.message: Class code 0511 (Fireworks or Explosives Manufacturing) is prohibited (MM-UW-CP-2025 2.3).

rules.subject: Policy
rules.message: A form may be attached only where the State Filing shows status Approved for the policy state (MM-UW-CP-2025 4.6; MM-FILINGS-CP-2025 4.1).

rules.subject: Policy
rules.message: Florida policies must include MM-CP-FL-01 Florida Amendatory Endorsement (MM-UW-CP-2025 4.2).

rules.subject: Policy
rules.message: MM-CP-E310 is mandatory for locations in FL Tier 1 coastal counties (FL-T03) and TX-T01 (MM-UW-CP-2025 4.3).

rules.subject: Location
rules.message: A location in flood zone A/AE/V/VE must be scheduled under MM-CP-E101 unless a Flood Exclusion Acknowledgment is signed (MM-UW-CP-2025 4.4).

rules.subject: Policy
rules.message: Underwriter must not bind a risk above his or her authority level (MM-UW-CP-2025 3.1).

rules.subject: Claim
rules.message: Building vacant more than 60 days: vandalism, sprinkler leakage, water damage and theft are not covered (MM-CP-0010 E.5).

rules.subject: Claim
rules.message: Adjuster must acknowledge a Florida claim in writing within 14 calendar days (MM-CM-CP-2025 1.2).
